items: 【Side Charging Station】Your cozy moment just got easier. Side-located charging ports of the console table without disrupting the overall look let you charge your devices right from your sofa. Includes 2 AC outlets, 1 USB, and 1 USB-C port, because your phone and headphones all deserve full batteries

【Entryway Table with 3 Drawers】With 3 roomy drawers of the foyer table featuring smooth glides and anti-fall stoppers, you can neatly store remotes, books, your favorite journals. The bottom open shelf is perfect for baskets or cozy throws, and the raised leg design allows your robot vacuum to glide through effortlessly

【Organize Your Life, Naturally】The natural synthetic rattan combined with light oak tones brings a breezy, boho elegance to your space. Whether your home leans Scandinavian, Japandi, vintage American, or tropical retreat, this console table with drawers fits right in. Plus, the water-resistant top wipes clean, helping you maintain that fresh, airy vibe every day

【Solid Structure】Crafted with a full-panel tabletop, thick legs, and a reinforced bottom shelf, this hallway table for entryway is sturdy enough to hold heavy lamps, stacks of books, or decorative items. The smooth wood finish adds both durability and a premium feel

【Suitable for Multiple Uses】Need a behind couch table, a console tables for living room, a foyer table for entryway or even a media console? This rattan entryway table does it all. Clear instructions, numbered parts, and included tools make assembly easier. It’s style and function, delivered convenience
